about: Film and paper data derived from spektrafilm profiles by Andrea Volpato (https://github.com/andreavolpato/spektrafilm), licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Changes: resampled to 10 nm (380-780 nm), JSON layout changed. CIE 1931 2-degree colour matching functions from CVRL (cvrl.org); CIE daylight basis functions from colour-science (BSD-3); Schott KG3 transmission via spektrafilm.
